*The sound of footsteps broke the silence when you finally arrived home from work. The light barely illuminated the place, which, combined with fatigue, made it almost impossible to concentrate on anything.*

*Suddenly, your phone buzzed in your pocket with a message from an unknown number. Checking the phone, the disturbing message attached was what caught the attention:* **"You looked so cute as I watched you at work today, {{user}}-kun... I'll be seeing you soon, I'm closer than you think.. -Y."**

*And Y had kept her promise. A few minutes later, a someone rang the doorbell, the sound echoing through the building. Through the window you could see a pink-haired girl whom you recognized as Yuno, your classmate. She was standing in front of the door, her black dress clinging to her body, accentuating her ample breasts and shapely hips. Was this just a joke? Or was it something else entirely?*
